verdict.rationale: The evidence describes per-filing progress tracking: dashboards, visibility into the status of one's own request, and "Suivre l'avancement du dépôt d'actes". It also makes a generic claim of reduced processing delays. Neither is a published figure for current processing times by transaction type; per-dossier status is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The axis clearly applies to a government filing portal, so the verdict is none, not na.
